passages.text: Of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David was a king of Israel.
David trusted God.
David often prayed to God.
David taught others about God.

passages.text: Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
passages.sermon:
David speaks.
He warns us.
Do not worry about people who do evil.
Do not envy people who do wrong.
passages.original: לְדָוִ֨ד׀ אַל־ תִּתְחַ֥ר בַּמְּרֵעִ֑ים אַל־ תְּ֝קַנֵּ֗א בְּעֹשֵׂ֥י עַוְלָֽה׃

passages.text: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
passages.sermon:
Evil people do wrong things.
They seem to succeed for a short time.
They wither quickly like grass.
They wilt like tender plants.
Their success does not last.
passages.original: כִּ֣י כֶ֭חָצִיר מְהֵרָ֣ה יִמָּ֑לוּ וּכְיֶ֥רֶק דֶּ֝֗שֶׁא יִבּוֹלֽוּן׃

passages.text: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the people.
He tells them to trust in the LORD.
He tells them to do good.
He tells them to live in the land.
He tells them to be faithful.
passages.original: בְּטַ֣ח בַּֽ֭יהוָה וַעֲשֵׂה־ ט֑וֹב שְׁכָן־ אֶ֝֗רֶץ וּרְעֵ֥ה אֱמוּנָֽה׃

passages.text: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
He is worthy of joy and devotion.
Find your delight in the LORD.
He will give you the desires of your heart.
passages.original: וְהִתְעַנַּ֥ג עַל־ יְהוָ֑ה וְיִֽתֶּן־ לְ֝ךָ֗ מִשְׁאֲלֹ֥ת לִבֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Commit your way to the LORD.
Trust in the LORD.
He will act.
passages.original: גּ֣וֹל עַל־ יְהוָ֣ה דַּרְכֶּ֑ךָ וּבְטַ֥ח עָ֝לָ֗יו וְה֣וּא יַעֲשֶֽׂה׃

passages.text: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
passages.sermon:
The LORD acts for you.
The LORD brings out your righteousness.
Your righteousness shines like the dawn.
The LORD brings out your justice.
Your justice shines like the noonday sun.
passages.original: וְהוֹצִ֣יא כָא֣וֹר צִדְקֶ֑ךָ וּ֝מִשְׁפָּטֶ֗ךָ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Be still before the LORD.
Wait patiently for the LORD.
Do not worry when people succeed in their ways.
Some people carry out wicked plans.
Do not fret because of them.
passages.original: דּ֤וֹם׀ לַיהוָה֮ וְהִתְח֪וֹלֵ֫ל ל֥וֹ אַל־ תִּ֭תְחַר בְּמַצְלִ֣יחַ דַּרְכּ֑וֹ בְּ֝אִ֗ישׁ עֹשֶׂ֥ה מְזִמּֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Refrain from anger and abandon wrath; do not fret—it can only bring harm.
passages.sermon:
God commands you to control your emotions.
Stop being angry.
Let go of your wrath.
Do not worry or become upset.
Worrying only leads to harm.
passages.original: הֶ֣רֶף מֵ֭אַף וַעֲזֹ֣ב חֵמָ֑ה אַל־ תִּ֝תְחַ֗ר אַךְ־ לְהָרֵֽעַ׃

passages.text: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
passages.sermon:
Evildoers act against God.
God will cut off evildoers.
Some people hope in the LORD.
Those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ מְ֭רֵעִים יִכָּרֵת֑וּן וְקֹוֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה הֵ֣מָּה יִֽירְשׁוּ־ אָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
passages.sermon:
The wicked are people who do evil.
Soon, the wicked will disappear.
You may look for the wicked in their place.
You will not find them.
They will be gone.
passages.original: וְע֣וֹד מְ֭עַט וְאֵ֣ין רָשָׁ֑ע וְהִתְבּוֹנַ֖נְתָּ עַל־ מְקוֹמ֣וֹ וְאֵינֶֽנּוּ׃

passages.text: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
passages.sermon: The meek will inherit the land.\r\nThe meek will enjoy great peace.\r\nThe meek will find abundant prosperity.
passages.original: וַעֲנָוִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־ אָ֑רֶץ וְ֝הִתְעַנְּג֗וּ עַל־ רֹ֥ב שָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them, but the Lord laughs, seeing that their day is coming.
passages.sermon:
The wicked plan against the righteous.
The wicked gnash their teeth at the righteous.
The Lord sees the wicked.
The Lord laughs at the wicked.
The Lord knows the day of the wicked is coming.
passages.original: זֹמֵ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וְחֹרֵ֖ק עָלָ֣יו שִׁנָּֽיו׃ אֲדֹנָ֥י יִשְׂחַק־ ל֑וֹ כִּֽי־ רָ֝אָ֗ה כִּֽי־ יָבֹ֥א יוֹמֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
passages.sermon:
The wicked act with violence.
They draw their swords.
They bend their bows.
They attack the poor.
They attack the needy.
They try to kill those who live upright lives.
passages.original: חֶ֤רֶב׀ פָּֽתְח֣וּ רְשָׁעִים֮ וְדָרְכ֪וּ קַ֫שְׁתָּ֥ם לְ֭הַפִּיל עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְי֑וֹן לִ֝טְב֗וֹחַ יִשְׁרֵי־ דָֽרֶךְ׃

passages.text: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
passages.sermon:
The wicked attack the righteous.
The wicked use swords and bows.
Their swords will pierce their own hearts.
Their bows will break.
passages.original: חַ֭רְבָּם תָּב֣וֹא בְלִבָּ֑ם וְ֝קַשְּׁתוֹתָ֗ם תִּשָּׁבַֽרְנָה׃

passages.text: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
passages.sermon:
The righteous person may have only a little.
This little is better than the great abundance of many wicked people.
The righteous person pleases God.
The wicked people have much, but their abundance does not please God.
God values the little that belongs to the righteous more than the plenty of the wicked.
passages.original: טוֹב־ מְ֭עַט לַצַּדִּ֑יק מֵ֝הֲמ֗וֹן רְשָׁעִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃

passages.text: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD supports people who do what is right.
Wicked people use their strength to do evil.
God will break the strength of wicked people.
God will not let the righteous fall.
God holds up the righteous.
passages.original: כִּ֤י זְרוֹע֣וֹת רְ֭שָׁעִים תִּשָּׁבַ֑רְנָה וְסוֹמֵ֖ךְ צַדִּיקִ֣ים יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
passages.sermon: The LORD knows the blameless.\r\nThe LORD knows their days.\r\nTheir inheritance will last forever.
passages.original: יוֹדֵ֣עַ יְ֭הוָה יְמֵ֣י תְמִימִ֑ם וְ֝נַחֲלָתָ֗ם לְעוֹלָ֥ם תִּהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
passages.sermon:
God protects the righteous.
The righteous will not feel shame during times of trouble.
The righteous will have enough food during times of famine.
God provides for them in every situation.
passages.original: לֹֽא־ יֵ֭בֹשׁוּ בְּעֵ֣ת רָעָ֑ה וּבִימֵ֖י רְעָב֣וֹן יִשְׂבָּֽעוּ׃

passages.text: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
passages.sermon:
The wicked will perish.
The enemies of the LORD will perish.
They will disappear like the beauty of a field.
They will vanish.
They will fade away like smoke.
passages.original: כִּ֤י רְשָׁעִ֨ים׀ יֹאבֵ֗דוּ וְאֹיְבֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה כִּיקַ֣ר כָּרִ֑ים כָּל֖וּ בֶעָשָׁ֣ן כָּֽלוּ׃

passages.text: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
passages.sermon:
The wicked person borrows.
The wicked person does not repay.
The righteous person is gracious.
The righteous person gives to others.
passages.original: לֹוֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע וְלֹ֣א יְשַׁלֵּ֑ם וְ֝צַדִּ֗יק חוֹנֵ֥ן וְנוֹתֵֽן׃

passages.text: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
passages.sermon:
The LORD blesses some people.
These blessed people will inherit the land.
The LORD curses other people.
These cursed people will be destroyed.
passages.original: כִּ֣י מְ֭בֹרָכָיו יִ֣ירְשׁוּ אָ֑רֶץ וּ֝מְקֻלָּלָ֗יו יִכָּרֵֽתוּ׃

passages.text: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
passages.sermon: The LORD guides a man's steps.\r\nThe LORD establishes his path.\r\nThe LORD delights in the man's journey.
passages.original: מֵ֭יְהוָה מִֽצְעֲדֵי־ גֶ֥בֶר כּוֹנָ֗נוּ וְדַרְכּ֥וֹ יֶחְפָּֽץ׃

passages.text: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
passages.sermon:
The LORD supports the righteous.
The LORD holds their hand.
If the righteous person falls, he will not be overwhelmed.
The LORD keeps him steady.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ יִפֹּ֥ל לֹֽא־ יוּטָ֑ל כִּֽי־ יְ֝הוָ֗ה סוֹמֵ֥ךְ יָדֽוֹ׃

passages.text: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
passages.sermon:
I was once young.
Now I am old.
I have never seen the righteous abandoned.
I have never seen their children begging for bread.
passages.original: נַ֤עַר׀ הָיִ֗יתִי גַּם־ זָ֫קַ֥נְתִּי וְֽלֹא־ רָ֭אִיתִי צַדִּ֣יק נֶעֱזָ֑ב וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ מְבַקֶּשׁ־ לָֽחֶם׃

passages.text: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
passages.sermon: The righteous person gives generously all day.\r\nThe righteous person lends to others.\r\nThe children of the righteous person are a blessing.
passages.original: כָּל־ הַ֭יּוֹם חוֹנֵ֣ן וּמַלְוֶ֑ה וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ לִבְרָכָֽה׃

passages.text: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
passages.sermon: God commands you to turn away from evil.\r\nGod tells you to do good.\r\nIf you do this, you will live forever in safety.
passages.original: ס֣וּר מֵ֭רָע וַעֲשֵׂה־ ט֗וֹב וּשְׁכֹ֥ן לְעוֹלָֽם׃

passages.text: For the LORD loves justice and will not forsake His saints. They are preserved forever, but the offspring of the wicked will be cut off.
passages.sermon:
The LORD loves justice.
The LORD will not abandon His faithful people.
He keeps His saints safe forever.
He destroys the children of the wicked.
passages.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָ֨ה׀ אֹ֘הֵ֤ב מִשְׁפָּ֗ט וְלֹא־ יַעֲזֹ֣ב אֶת־ חֲ֭סִידָיו לְעוֹלָ֣ם נִשְׁמָ֑רוּ וְזֶ֖רַע רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽת׃

passages.text: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
passages.sermon:
The righteous are people who do what is right.
God gives the land to the righteous.
The righteous will live in the land.
They will stay there forever.
passages.original: צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִֽירְשׁוּ־ אָ֑רֶץ וְיִשְׁכְּנ֖וּ לָעַ֣ד עָלֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
passages.sermon: A righteous man speaks.\r\nHe uses his mouth to say wise things.\r\nHe uses his tongue to speak about justice.
passages.original: פִּֽי־ צַ֭דִּיק יֶהְגֶּ֣ה חָכְמָ֑ה וּ֝לְשׁוֹנ֗וֹ תְּדַבֵּ֥ר מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

passages.text: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
passages.sermon:
A righteous person keeps God's law in his heart.
God's law guides him from within.
His steps remain steady.
He does not stumble.
passages.original: תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהָ֣יו בְּלִבּ֑וֹ לֹ֖א תִמְעַ֣ד אֲשֻׁרָיו׃

passages.text: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them, the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
passages.sermon:
The wicked person watches the righteous person.
The wicked person tries to kill the righteous person.
The LORD does not leave the righteous person in the power of the wicked.
The LORD does not let the righteous person be condemned when he is judged.
passages.original: צוֹפֶ֣ה רָ֭שָׁע לַצַּדִּ֑יק וּ֝מְבַקֵּ֗שׁ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃ יְ֭הוָה לֹא־ יַעַזְבֶ֣נּוּ בְיָד֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יַ֝רְשִׁיעֶ֗נּוּ בְּהִשָּׁפְטֽוֹ׃

passages.text: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
Wait for the LORD.
Keep the LORD’s way.
The LORD will raise you up.
You will inherit the land.
The LORD will cut off the wicked.
You will see when the wicked are cut off.
passages.original: קַוֵּ֤ה אֶל־ יְהוָ֨ה׀ וּשְׁמֹ֬ר דַּרְכּ֗וֹ וִֽ֭ירוֹמִמְךָ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אָ֑רֶץ בְּהִכָּרֵ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים תִּרְאֶֽה׃

passages.text: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree, yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
passages.sermon:
I saw a wicked man.
He was ruthless.
He flourished.
He grew strong like a well-rooted tree.
Then he passed away.
He was gone.
I looked for him.
I could not find him.
passages.original: רָ֭אִיתִי רָשָׁ֣ע עָרִ֑יץ וּ֝מִתְעָרֶ֗ה כְּאֶזְרָ֥ח רַעֲנָֽן׃ וַ֭יַּֽעֲבֹר וְהִנֵּ֣ה אֵינֶ֑נּוּ וָֽ֝אֲבַקְשֵׁ֗הוּ וְלֹ֣א נִמְצָֽא׃

passages.text: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
passages.sermon:
A blameless person lives with integrity.
An upright person acts honestly and justly.
Watch the blameless person.
Look at the upright person.
A man of peace has a good future.
God gives a lasting future to the man of peace.
passages.original: שְׁמָר־ תָּ֭ם וּרְאֵ֣ה יָשָׁ֑ר כִּֽי־ אַחֲרִ֖ית לְאִ֣ישׁ שָׁלֽוֹם׃

passages.text: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
passages.sermon:
Transgressors are people who break God's law.
God will destroy all transgressors together.
Wicked people do evil.
God will cut off the future of the wicked.
The wicked will have no lasting future.
passages.original: וּֽ֭פֹשְׁעִים נִשְׁמְד֣וּ יַחְדָּ֑ו אַחֲרִ֖ית רְשָׁעִ֣ים נִכְרָֽתָה׃

passages.text: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
passages.sermon:
The LORD gives salvation to the righteous.
The righteous receive help from the LORD.
The LORD is a stronghold for the righteous.
The LORD protects them in times of trouble.
passages.original: וּתְשׁוּעַ֣ת צַ֭דִּיקִים מֵיְהוָ֑ה מָֽ֝עוּזָּ֗ם בְּעֵ֣ת צָרָֽה׃

passages.text: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the subject.
The LORD helps the righteous.
The LORD delivers the righteous.
The LORD rescues the righteous from the wicked.
The LORD saves the righteous from the wicked.
The righteous take refuge in the LORD.
The LORD acts because the righteous trust in Him.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעְזְרֵ֥ם יְהוָ֗ה וַֽיְפַ֫לְּטֵ֥ם יְפַלְּטֵ֣ם מֵ֭רְשָׁעִים וְיוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם כִּי־ חָ֥סוּ בֽוֹ׃
